methods.description: Read published provider/resource and official STAC metadata; no assets or pixels requested. Full component geometry was authenticated against the original custody payload, but no item geometry overlay or pixel review was done.

conclusions.text: No reviewed source meets the evidence needed to qualify for any of the 15 Makira components; Sentinel records remain screening candidates only and all exact coverage, asset lineage, rights and component-level fitness are unresolved.
The shared Makira ADM1 contact is contextual administrative association only; its effective date and authority are unapproved.
